description: NaHSeO₃ crystallizes in the monoclinic C2/c space group. There are two inequivalent Na sites. In the first Na site, Na is bonded to six O atoms to form a mixture of corner and edge-sharing NaO₆ octahedra. There are a spread of Na-O bond distances ranging from 2.41-2.51 Å. In the second Na site, Na is bonded to five O atoms to form distorted NaO₅ trigonal bipyramids that share corners with three equivalent NaO₆ octahedra, corners with two equivalent NaO₅ trigonal bipyramids, and  an edgeedge with one NaO₆ octahedra. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles range from 62-80°. There are a spread of Na-O bond distances ranging from 2.35-2.69 Å. There are two inequivalent H sites. In the first H site, H is bonded in a linear geometry to two O atoms. There is one shorter (1.03 Å) and one longer (1.60 Å) H-O bond length. In the second H site, H is bonded in a distorted single-bond geometry to two O atoms. There is one shorter (1.02 Å) and one longer (1.70 Å) H-O bond length. There are two inequivalent Se sites. In the first Se site, Se is bonded in a trigonal non-coplanar geometry to three O atoms. There are a spread of Se-O bond distances ranging from 1.69-1.86 Å. In the second Se site, Se is bonded in a trigonal non-coplanar geometry to three O atoms. There are a spread of Se-O bond distances ranging from 1.70-1.84 Å. There are six inequivalent O sites. In the first O site, O is bonded in a trigonal planar geometry to two Na and one Se atom. In the second O site, O is bonded in a 3-coordinate geometry to one Na, one H, and one Se atom. In the third O site, O is bonded to two Na, one H, and one Se atom to form a mixture of distorted corner and edge-sharing ONa₂HSe trigonal pyramids. In the fourth O site, O is bonded in a distorted single-bond geometry to one Na, one H, and one Se atom. In the fifth O site, O is bonded to three Na and one Se atom to form distorted ONa₃Se tetrahedra that share corners with two equivalent ONa₃Se tetrahedra, corners with two equivalent ONa₂HSe trigonal pyramids, and  an edgeedge with one ONa₂HSe trigonal pyramid. In the sixth O site, O is bonded in a distorted single-bond geometry to two Na, one H, and one Se atom.
